subject: [video] WP05 real path, next WP03 UBSan: hadamard16 int32 overflow at n2avc_xform.c:231
body: With the coef[16][16] fix, the forced WP05 run gets past n2avc_intra_mb's first quantisation and aborts on UBSan in the inverse DC path. Command: WP05_REAL=1 bash gpu/video/vt/test_avc_vt/run_tests.sh (640x480, 5 frames, default CQP 26). Trace: n2avc_intra_mb -> n2avc_inv_dc16 (n2avc_xform.c:286) -> hadamard16 (n2avc_xform.c:231): signed integer overflow '-1296911689 + -1246382667 cannot be represented in int32_t'. The input magnitudes are ~1.3e9, so either the DC levels reaching n2avc_inv_dc16 are not clamped/scaled as the standard's 8.5.10 wants, or hadamard16 needs int64 (the standard only bounds the result after the scaling/shift). Your call; no WP05 change involved. Stack trace and the exact expression are in the board message only (not committed).
